judge_verdict.summary: The agent answered 0% after mis-scoping conditions and filtering to keyword-matched immune pathway names, but the reference ORA on four min-p screening conditions yields 25%.

verdict.outcome_rationale: This is a genuine agent-fault failure and the verifier's FAIL is correct. The hidden grader compared the submitted answer to the reference value 25% using exact percentage matching and scored reward 0.0 because the agent wrote 0% [1][2]. The task asks for the share of non-control screening conditions with adjusted p<0.05 pathway enrichment [3], and the reference solution documents the intended workflow—per-condition enrichment after excluding no-T-cells controls—with the known-correct result 25% [4]. The agent ran a lengthy analysis but never used gseapy's gp.enrich ORA that the capsule workflow relies on; instead it built custom hypergeometric tests and, critically, required pathways to match an immune-keyword regex before counting a condition as significant [5]. That ORA sweep across parameter variants reported count 0 and pct 0.0 for all eight replicate-level columns it treated as conditions [5], after which it pivoted to preranked GSEA (also keyword-filtered) and ultimately terminated the longer GSEA job before writing printf '0%%' to /workspace/answer.txt [6][7]. The correct answer is 1 of 4 biological screening conditions (acute plus three chronic rounds, each aggregated by minimum MAGeCK p-value across replicates): chronic round 2 alone shows significant Reactome enrichment at adjusted p<0.05, giving 25% [4]. The agent's 0% reflects a substantive methodological misinterpretation—counting keyword-tagged immune pathway names and replicate columns rather than the four min-p screening conditions with any significant enrichment—so the task was not truly solved despite a serious effort [5][6][7].

What percentage of screening conditions, excluding no T cells control, showed significant enrichment (adjusted p-value < 0.05) of immune-relevant pathways?

Analyze the data files in `/workspace/`.

Write your final answer — just the number — to `/workspace/answer.txt`.

citations.quote:
"question": "What percentage of screening conditions, excluding no T cells control, showed significant enrichment (adjusted p-value < 0.05) of immune-relevant pathways?",
  "ideal_answer": "25%"

#   load per-condition pathway enrichment, exclude the no-T-cells control, mark conditions with an immune pathway at adjusted p<0.05, divide hits by non-control conditions (as a percentage),

#
# Re-deriving the value requires the per-task BixBench dataset (downloaded into the
# task container), so this reference writes the known-correct answer that the
# verifier checks against rather than re-running the full analysis here.
echo '25%' > /workspace/answer.txt
